title: Smiling Mother Holding Baby on Couch, 1950s B&W Domestic Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white home snapshot featuring a smiling mother seated on a sofa while holding her infant baby in her lap. The woman wears a classic 1950s short curly hairstyle and a light-colored collared shirt. In the background, patterned curtains hang behind the sofa alongside a metal folding tray table, reflecting everyday suburban home life in mid-century America.
